messages.subject: Time recording — November narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Reminder: November time narratives are due by close on Wednesday for billing. Several entries on open matters are missing narratives. Please complete in the time system to avoid delay to the December bills.

Thank you,
Accounts
